general.notes: Passive QSFP28 to 4x SFP28 direct attach copper cable (DAC); no optical emitter or photodetector. Power supply +3.3V stated in Features. Copper link length up to 5m; mechanical lengths 1, 2, 3, 5 m with AWG 30 (1–3 m) and AWG 24 (5 m). Insertion loss 22.48 dB at 12.8906 GHz. Channel Operating Margin (COM) min 3 dB. Datasheet header references LQ-DAC11100-xMN on some pages while product title is LQ-DAC14100-xMN.
general.suggestions: Add schema fields for passive copper DAC: cable length variants (m), AWG, differential impedance (Ω), channel operating margin (dB), and electrical insertion/return loss vs frequency; reach_km could accept meters or a paired value+unit.
